name: Wings to Fly
source:
Eddie is a puppy beastman who has been curious about the sky. On that day, his curiosity peaked and he ended up trying to find a way to fly.

[From [url=https://hitamitu.itch.io/wings-to-fly]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Eddie是一名小狗獸人，一直對天空充滿好奇。那一天，他的好奇心終於達到頂點，開始設法尋找飛翔的方法。

[摘自[url=https://hitamitu.itch.io/wings-to-fly]Itch.io[/url]]
